name: of1-recommendation-hero-pick
description: One standout recommended plan presented as a big hero pick, backed by personalized reasons and a couple of secondary alternatives.

slots.instruction: Short kicker above the headline setting the recommendation context.
Personalized headline naming the single recommended plan for the visitor's situation.
One-sentence benefit-first summary of why this setup fits the visitor.
Primary hero call to action linking to the recommendation or order flow.
Product image for the recommended pick. Use a real Xfinity asset URL.
Badge label flagging this as the top recommendation.
Name of the recommended product.
Monthly price of the recommended product.
Short pricing reassurance such as contract or price-guarantee terms.
Paragraph describing the recommended product and its core benefits.
Bulleted list of the top features of the recommended product.
Call to action to select the recommended product.
Heading introducing the personalized reasons this pick fits the visitor.
List of personalized reasons the recommendation matches the visitor's needs.
Heading introducing the secondary alternative options.
Name of the first alternative product.
Monthly price of the first alternative.
Short description of the first alternative product.
Link to view or select the first alternative.
Name of the second alternative product.
Monthly price of the second alternative.
Short description of the second alternative product.
Link to view or select the second alternative.
Name of the third alternative product.
Monthly price of the third alternative.
Short description of the third alternative product.
Link to view or select the third alternative.
Closing call-to-action heading.
Closing call-to-action supporting copy.
Final call to action to start the order.
